sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: Monday this tab went 1-0 (the Under). Today: Dimers and Covers both pick Denver in Memphis.

straight.reasoning: Two sources agree. Dimers' model gives Denver a 67.7% chance to win, against about 60% implied by the price. Covers also takes Denver: Jokic working from the perimeter and setting screens should pull Zach Edey away from the rim. Playable to -160 (about 62¢ on Kalshi).

sections.label: NBA
sections.slate: 10 games tonight, starting with Cavaliers @ Knicks at 4:00 PM PT. Sources split on Warriors-Rockets, Thunder-Blazers and Wizards-Pacers, so those are skipped.

sections.label: College Hoops
sections.slate: Big college basketball Wednesday. The headline game is Marquette @ Michigan (4:00 PM PT). All three picks come from one source each, so they're quarter units.

straight.reasoning: RotoWire takes the better offensive team at home. Marquette's top-ranked defense has come against weak opponents, and Michigan's loss to UConn on Friday was against a strong team. The line opened at -4. Playable to -4.

straight.event: NCAAB · Stephen F. Austin vs Abilene Christian
straight.reasoning: Dimers' model gives Abilene Christian a 58.4% chance to cover, one of its top spread edges today. Playable to +4.

straight.pick: Nevada vs UC Santa Barbara OVER 144.5
straight.reasoning: RotoWire likes the Over. Nevada has scored 86 and 96 in its first two games, and UCSB's defense ranks only 130th in adjusted efficiency. Price is an estimate; skip if the total is above 146.
